title: Route Gossip in Mesh Topology
description: This scenario explores route gossip dynamics within a mesh communication topology. The disturbance creates coordination challenges that test the agents' ability to adapt, communicate effectively, and maintain freight flow under adverse conditions.
edge_cases_to_watch: Information spreads gradually through the network
Agents far from source learn last
Information Echo: Agents receiving outdated gossip from different neighbors causing path oscillation
Network Partitioning: Communication mesh remains intact while physical routing becomes impossible
Capacity Bottleneck: Sudden diversion of traffic from 'west-south' to 'west-east' causing congestion on the east corridor
coordination_challenges: Stale Information Management: Agents acting on route status that has changed since their last update
Gossip Congestion: High frequency of updates consuming agent bandwidth/processing
Conflict Resolution: Two agents attempting to utilize the single-capacity 'east-north' route simultaneously due to rerouting
Inconsistent Global State: Discrepancy between what Agent A knows and what Agent D knows about the closed route
suggested_agent_strategies: Timestamped Gossip: Attach temporal metadata to route updates to prevent regressing to older states
Proactive Redundancy: High-priority jobs (e.g., j-001, j-004) should seek alternative paths before the route closure signal reaches the agent
Majority Consensus: Agents wait for confirmation from multiple neighbors before committing to a significant route change
Congestion Awareness: Dynamically adjust capacity assumptions based on observed neighbor traffic density

coordination_challenges: Information spreads gradually through the network
Agents far from source learn last

success_criteria: Agents adapt communication to topology constraints
Recovery from disruption within expected turns
Minimization of 'stale-route' movements (unnecessary turns taken on closed routes)
